Jordan / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We
re excited to move Pulseware onto a 6-week pilot (up to $18k total) to validate the integration and throughput characteristics. A couple of procurement items to unblock billing on our side:

- Our standard process requires a PO for vendor invoices. For short pilots we can approve an "invoice-only" path if certain controls are in place (see questions below).
- Attached: onboarding form + SOW draft.

Can you confirm whether Pulseware can:
1) Provide a W-9 and current insurance certificate?
2) Share any third-party security attestations (SOC 2 / ISO) or a brief security questionnaire reply?
3) Accept a PO-waiver (DocuSign) limited to this pilot and countersigned by Redwood Finance if required?
4) Confirm billing email and remit address for invoices?

If you can supply 1-2 quickly wean route the pilot as invoice-only under an allowlist path and avoid the delay of a formal PO setup. If not, wean run the standard PO path but that will add ~2 weeks.

Karthik / Marissa: looping you to confirm the approval ladder and any additional evidence Finance needs for the invoice-only option.

Next steps: Jordan, if youan reply with the items above Ian collect evidence and push for the waive-PO route.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Camila —

Thanks for the context. Finance is willing to approve an invoice-only (no-PO) route for short pilots under the following conditions:

- Threshold: pilot spend <= $25,000 total. (Pulseware pilot at $18k fits.)
- Evidence: vendor allowlist requires current W-9, proof of insurance, and either a SOC 2 report OR a signed security attestation we can accept. If SOC 2 is in progress we can accept a security questionnaire + statement of controls from vendor CISO.
- Approval ladder: AE (Camila) -> Finance Manager (Marissa) -> Finance Director (Karthik) for final waive sign-off.
- Legal / contract: for pilots we prefer a signed SOW; if legal determines any special terms we will require a DocuSign addendum.
- Controls on our side: invoice must reference the pilot SOW id and include the Redwood cost center string; Finance will not create a PO but will process the invoice via a PO-waiver batch.

Please have the vendor sign the attached one-off PO-waiver (I can send via DocuSign) and provide the security evidence. Also clarify if any data residency restrictions apply during the trial (some teammates will ask).

If you want, Ian prepare the DocuSign waiver and a short checklist for the vendor to complete.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
